name: Sika® Plug
summary: Sika® Plug is a chloride free, ready for use powder based on high alumina cement. When mixed with water Sika® Plug becomes a rapid setting plugging mortar.

Rapid setting and high early strength gain.

usage: Sika® Plug is a chloride free, ready for use powder based on high alumina cement. When mixed with water Sika® Plug becomes a rapid setting plugging mortar. Sika® Plug can be used to seal leaks as a pre-treatment to the installation of Sikalastic 1K cementitious waterproofing syetem.
advantages: Easy to use and mix just add water.
Rapid setting and high early strength gain.
Rapid water-stopping capacity and hydraulic resistance.
No cracking and very low shrinkage.

items.label: Compressive strength
items.text:
6 hours | ~ 10 MPa
1 day | ~ 12 MPa
7 days | ~ 18 MPa
28 days | ~ 25 MPa
Material and curing conditions at 23°C / 50% r.h. The above results are based on 50mm x 50mm cubes

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text:
3 parts powder : 1 part water
(approx. by mass)

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Depending on the site conditions and due to the rapid curing of the product only small quantities may be mixed at any one time. Thoroughly and quickly the powder and water in a suitable container. Mix only the amount that can be immediately applied by gloved hand or trowel.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Quickly work the mixed mortar firmly into the leaking crevice, V-cut, joint etc. and hold in place with a gloved hand or trowel until the mortar is sufficiently hard to remain in place. Strike off flush with the surface if desired. Repeat this procedure, mixing small quantities at a time until the seepage or leak is stemmed.
If the water pressure is too high a timber plug maybe installed then covered with Sika® Plug.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and equipment immediately after use with water. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically.
